# Easel

Easel is an offline-first personal whiteboard. Its browser app is available at /app.

To install a new instance, confirm the host and access scope with the operator, then follow the Docker deployment guide. Keep SQLite on a named Docker volume. Open the instance, choose Open whiteboard, draw a shape, reload, and confirm it persists.

- Source: https://github.com/niltavi/easel
- Docker deployment: https://github.com/niltavi/easel/blob/main/docs/en/deploy.md
- Agent installation and verification: https://github.com/niltavi/easel/blob/main/docs/en/for-agents.md
